summary.text: Karl Gillespie is a Republican state representative from North Carolina House District 120 who has served since January 1, 2021, and is running for re-election on November 3, 2026.
He is the House Majority Whip, and the General Assembly lists his occupation as communications contractor and farmer.

paragraphs.text: Gillespie's career experience includes work as vice president of Globe Communications and as president and founder of National Communications, Inc., according to Ballotpedia.
He succeeded Republican Kevin Corbin in House District 120, which the General Assembly lists as covering Cherokee, Clay, Graham and Macon counties.

Gillespie chairs the House Agriculture and Environment Committee and the Appropriations Subcommittee on Agriculture and Natural and Economic Resources, and is vice chairman of the Appropriations Committee and the House Select Committee on Helene Recovery.
He co-chairs the Joint Legislative Oversight Committee on Agriculture and Natural and Economic Resources and the Agriculture and Forestry Awareness Study Commission.
